scripts.text:
[Spectator]
If you tell me to not go in, isn't it going to make me want to go inside even more? But it doesn't look like there's anything interesting to see.
I see no monsters here...
scripts.translation:
[觀眾]
如果你讓我別進去，我反而會更想進去看看。不過看起來裡面也沒什麼特別有趣的東西。
這裡沒有魔物...

scripts.text:
[Passerby]
No... I'm just passing by. I don't want to go inside...
scripts.translation:
[路人]
不...我只是路過而已。我不想進去...

scripts.text:
[Traveler]
Rumors have been spreading that there are monsters living here. People claim to hear the ground rumbling because of them...
scripts.translation:
[旅行者]
最近有傳言說這裡有魔物居住。人們說能聽到地面因為它們的緣故而震動...

scripts.text:
[Traveler]
I want to go explore inside...
scripts.translation:
[旅行者]
我想進去探索一下...

scripts.text:
[Adventurer]
Do you think there's going to be treasure inside this place?
scripts.translation:
[冒險者]
你覺得這個地方里面會有寶藏嗎？

scripts.text:
[Adventurer]
It kind of smells like it...
scripts.translation:
[冒險者]
感覺聞起來像是有的樣子...
